import ida_hexrays,idautils,ida_funcs,ida_bytes,ida_nalt,json
refs=[]
for ea in (0x4b9970,0x4be854):
 for x in idautils.XrefsTo(ea):
  f=ida_funcs.get_func(x.frm)
  refs.append({'target':hex(ea),'from':hex(x.frm),'function':hex(f.start_ea) if f else None})
functions=[]
for ea in sorted(set(int(r['function'],16) for r in refs if r['function'])):
 c=ida_hexrays.decompile(ea)
 functions.append({'address':hex(ea),'code':str(c) if c else None})
print(json.dumps({'input':ida_nalt.get_input_file_path(),'references':refs,'functions':functions}))
